violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. EHS was shown a picture of a certification, however, EHS could not verify expiration date and certification number due to the quality of the picture.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS WAS ABLE TO VERIFY CFM INFORMATION FOR ANOTHER INDIVIDUAL WHO ARRIVED PRIOR TO THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM WAS ABLE TO OBTAIN A COPY OF HIS CERTIFICATE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink in the kitchen and the soap near the bar was mostly water.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. SOAP WAS ADDED TO BOTH CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: in the walk in cooler trays of eggs were stored on the shelf above raw produce.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EGGS WERE RELOCATED TO A LOWER SHELF.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. STAFF FIXED EQUIPMENT. EHS OBSERVED AT LEAST 50PPM.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: shrimp and packaged fish observed in standing water in the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. FACUET WAS TURNED ON.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: Bev air refrigerated prep unit, Avantco refrigerated prep unit, 2 drawer refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. FACILITY TO USE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: soup (45°F), chorizo (45°F), black beans (45°F) in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. AFTER DISCUSSION WITH CFM, FACILITY RECEIVED A DELIVERY LESS THAN 2 HRS AGO. DOOR OF WIC WAS OPEN FOR A PERIOD OF TIME. FOODS WERE ICED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a large stainless steel mixing bowl in the basin of the kitchen hand sink. Observed an owner dump dirty water into the bar area hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED THAT ALL SINKS HAVE A PURPOSE. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY. DO NOT USE FOR STORAGE OF EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, OR DUMPING. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing signage at the bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH HAND WASHING SIGN TO BE POSTED.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: a large container of cooked charro beans (48f-50f) in the walk in refrigerator. Bean were cooked the day before.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED THE CHARRO BEANS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a jar of boba (46f) in the 3DR bar cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE JAR OF BOBA TO THE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. EHS observed a bottle of Gorilla Glue spray adhesive in an area storing dishes, glasses, and other single-use items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE GORILLA GLUE TO UNDER THE CASH REGISTER AND AWAY FROM ANY FOOD ITEMS. PHO BANH MI & GRILL (Inspection Date: 02/25/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: EHS observed three chemical spray bottles without any identification label in the chemical storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO LABEL ALL WORKING CHEMICAL BOTTLES TO ENSURE PROPER USE AND STORAGE.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed a staff’s personal care items stored in an area storing dishes, glasses, and other single-use items.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT MOVING THE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS TO A DESIGNATED LOCATION AWAY FROM ANY FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: EHS observed several squeeze bottles of various sauces in the 2DR prep cooler without labels. EHS also observed squeeze bottles of oil and other liquids, and shakers along the service line without labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL WORKING CONTAINERS NEED LABELS. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed fry oil and bulk ingredient buckets being stored directly on the floor in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO PURCHASE NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACK TO KEEP FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) boba spoons were being stored in a container of water; 2) rice scoops were being stored in a container of water; 3) knives were being stored in between the prep coolers of the service line; 4) cups and deli containers were found in bulk storage containers of rice, flour, salt, sugar, etc.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT PROPER STORAGE OF IN-USE UTENSILS. IMPROPER STORAGE OF UTENSILS IN WATER WITH CONTRIBUTE TO BACTERIAL GROWTH. PHO BANH MI & GRILL (Inspection Date: 02/25/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Clean containers and pans were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT CONTAINERS NEED TO AIR DRY IN ORDER TO BE PROPERLY SANITIZED. PLEASE TRAIN STAFF TO ALLOW CLEAN DISHES TO AIR DRY BEFORE STORING BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed a box of single service items (take out containers/lids) on the floor in the back hallway.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT NOTHING SHALL BE IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE FLOOR. ELEVATE ITEMS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR USING NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: two Home Depot buckets were observed storing dried spices.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO MOVE THE DRIED SPICES OUT OF THE HOME DEPOT BUCKETS INTO NSF APPROVED STORAGE BUCKETS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the pre-scrape basin.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO TRAIN STAFF TO HANG THE HOSE AT ALL TIMES TO PREVENT A POSSIBLE BACK FLOW ISSUE. MANAGER WILL ORDER A SHORTER HOSE AND NEW SPRING BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the small gaps in the ceiling panels where plumbing and wiring are located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO FILL THE GAPS TO PREVENT PESTS FROM ENTERING THEIR FACILITY. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, In Designated Room/Area
violations.observation: Observed staff’s personal belongings such as coats, jackets, etc stored with glassware, single service items, dry goods, etc at both the bar and in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate lockers and personal storage facilities to prevent the potential contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, linens, or single-service items. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT DESIGNATING A LOCATION FOR STAFF TO USE AT ALL TIMES FOR STORAGE OF PERSONAL BELONGINGS. THIS AREA SHOULD BE SEPARATE FROM FOOD, CLEAN EQUIPMENT, CLEAN UTENSILS, DRY GOODS, CLEAN LINENS, AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
